title: Multimodal Approaches to Fair Image Classification: An Ethical Perspective
findings: The paper had no findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the research. The term 'Bishop of Llandaff' was mentioned as a class name for a flower, but this was incidental and not part of an analysis of religion.
